_comment: Adepta Sororitas Faction Pack v1.4. Complete datasheet and enhancement rules.

Acts of Faith.note: Substitute 1 dice roll per phase per unit using a Miracle die (sororitas.ts)

Righteous Repugnance.note: When selected to shoot or fight, discard 1 Miracle die to add 3 to the Attacks of Fidelis and the Lance of Illumination. Gain 1 Miracle die when an enemy unit is destroyed by this model.

SUPREME COMMANDER.note: Checked by the army builder: Morvenn Vahl must be your Warlord.

Rapturous Blows.note: When selected to fight, discard 1 Miracle die: melee attacks that wound inflict 1 mortal wound.

The Emperor’s Grace.note: Once per battle, at start of any phase, this model has a 2+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Divine Deliverance.note: Once per battle, in Fight phase, melee weapons have +3 Attacks and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

Sacred Command.note: Once per battle round, reduce the CP cost of a Stratagem targeting this unit by 1CP.

One Shot.note: The bearer can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.

Litany of Deeds.note: Re-roll Miracle dice of 1, 2, or 3 gained when an Adepta Sororitas unit is destroyed within 12".

Sacred Healing.note: While leading a unit, in Command phase, return 1 destroyed model (or discard 1 Miracle die to return D3+1 models).

Laud Hailer.note: Once per battle, at start of any phase, select 1 friendly AS unit within 12": no longer Battle-shocked.

Stirring Rhetoric.note: While leading a unit, each Miracle die used in an Act of Faith is changed to an unmodified 6.

Cherub.note: Once per battle, after performing an Act of Faith, gain 1 Miracle die.

Cherubs.note: Twice per battle, after performing an Act of Faith, gain 1 Miracle die.

Defenders of the Faith.note: Sticky objectives: an objective marker controlled by this unit remains under your control until opponent controls it.

Simulacrum Imperialis.note: At end of Command phase, for each controlled objective with unit in range, roll D6: on 4+, gain 1 Miracle die of that value.

Angelic Ascent.note: In Shooting phase, after shooting, if not engaged, make a Normal move of up to 6" (cannot charge this turn).

Righteous Awareness.note: In opponent's Movement phase, if enemy ends move within 8", make a Normal move of up to D6".

Holy Vanguard.note: Attached Leader gains Scouts 6" if starting embarked.

Self Repair.note: At start of your Command phase, this model regains 1 lost wound.

Purge and Cleanse.note: In Shooting phase, after shooting, enemy unit hit cannot have Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Devastating Refrain.note: After shooting with Indirect Fire weapon and hitting an enemy unit, that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Zealot.note: Once per battle, in Fight phase, melee weapons have +3 Strength and +3 Attacks.

Holy Mission.note: Attached to Dominion Squad gains Scouts 6"; attached to Sisters Novitiate Squad gains Infiltrators.

Solemn Procession.note: Miracle die gained at start of turn has value 6 while on the battlefield.

Simulacrum of the Ebon Chalice (Aura).note: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6" can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase.

Fiery Conviction.note: In Command phase, discard 1 Miracle die to gain 1CP, or pass a Leadership test to gain 1CP.

Recount the Deeds of the Saints.note: Gain 1 Miracle die when destroying an enemy unit; gain D3 Miracle dice when Agathae Dolan is destroyed.

Rites of Castigation.note: In Shooting phase, after shooting and hitting an enemy unit, friendly Adepta Sororitas ranged attacks targeting that enemy unit gain +1 AP.

Impetuous Fervour.note: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 (or all Hit rolls if targeting an enemy within range of an objective marker).

Holy Judgement.note: In Shooting phase, select enemy within 12": Battle-shock test (-2 if CHAOS). If failed, 3 mortal wounds.

Mysterious Saviours.note: Can target this unit with Heroic Intervention for 0CP without preventing other uses.

Salvationist Medikit.note: In your Command phase, if on battlefield, return up to D3 destroyed models.

Denuncia Oratory.note: Select a new quarry when the current quarry is destroyed.

Righteous Denunciation.note: At start of Fight phase, each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Judged for Execution.note: At end of Movement phase, select enemy within 18": friendly Adepta Sororitas attacks targeting it have [LETHAL HITS].

Extremis Trigger Word.note: When selected to fight, can invoke extremis trigger word: until end of phase, arco-flails have A=6 and [HAZARDOUS].

Miraculous Intervention.note: First time Celestine is destroyed, roll D6 at end of phase: on 2+, return with full wounds.

Healing Tears.note: While Celestine is in unit, in Command phase, return 1 destroyed Geminae Superia model.
